n513dd9eaa4.headline: Oil price rises as Kazakh turmoil adds to supply worries | The Jerusalem Post
n513dd9eaa4.summary: Oil prices rose as unrest escalated in Kazakhstan and the political situation in Libya deteriorated, threatening to sideline Libyan output. Markets reacted with jitters.
